headlines.title: Supreme Court allows Trump’s ‘third country’ deportation policy
headlines.description: This is the second time the court has rejected lower court rulings that immigrants must be able to object before being sent to countries to which they have no previous connection.

headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s administration paid for TV ads showing him in a favorable light using money intended for U.S.

headlines.title: Trump’s border wall construction cut into an ancient ground carving older than Stonehenge
headlines.description: The Las Playas intaglio carving of a huge fish is at least two thousand years older than the first Egyptian pyramid, according to researchers’ recent estimations.

headlines.title: Trump says he will sign executive order naming AI as Super Intelligence
headlines.description: During an event launching the website America.gov, President Trump said that he will be signing an executive order renaming artificial intelligence to super intelligence.

headlines.title: Jack Smith testifies at Senate hearing, defending decision to charge Trump
headlines.description: Jack Smith appeared before the Senate Judiciary Committee amid the Justice Department’s push to target law enforcement officials involved with his investigation into President Trump. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports on how Smith responded to senators.

headlines.title: Caleb Flynn, former ‘American Idol’ singer, found guilty of wife’s murder
headlines.description: Former “American Idol” singer Caleb Flynn was found guilty of murder on Tuesday in the death of his wife, who was killed in their Ohio home in February.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy’s defense says prosecution did not prove she killed her children
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy and her legal team returned to court for the first hearing since Clancy’s triple murder trial ended in a mistrial. Her attorney argued that the state of Massachusetts failed to prove she killed her children. NBC News’ Steven Romo reports on the holdout juror in the spotlight and where the case is headed.

headlines.title: 5 Men Arrested Near UK Air Base by US Forces Released on Bail
headlines.description: New details are emerging about the potential terror plot targeting a US-operated military base in the U.K, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio alleging for the first time that a foreign government was involved. Authorities decided to release all five suspects on bail without being charged. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Cornell Sexual Assault Investigation Reopened by Prosecutors
headlines.description: Prosecutors say they have now reopened the case of an alleged sexual assault at Cornell University with plans to have the former student, who’s now filed a civil lawsuit against the school, tell her story to a grand jury. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY. Warning: Some of the details of the lawsuit are disturbing.

headlines.title: Anger grows across Spain after elderly woman is evicted from her home of 70 years
headlines.description: An 87-year-old Spanish woman was forcibly evicted Wednesday from the Madrid apartment she had lived in for more than 70 years, in a case that highlights a growing housing crisis in the country.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.
